addr: Manvi Convention, Hsr Layout, 1184, 11th Cross Rd, 1st Sector, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102, India

rev.t:
One of the good convention centre which I came across in recent times.
Got very good car parking, in case the parking is full, one can park at the ground near to conventional hall. …

Good place for a wedding or any other family function.

Had been there for a wedding and liked the hall, though slightly compact it was …

Attended a marriage reception at Manvi Convention Center. The decoration and lighting were truly impressive, creating a beautiful ambiance. Ample parking made access easy. However, there's room for improvement in the food quality. Overall, a pleasant experience.
